[Documentation](../../docs.html) / [Question types](../../docs.html#question-types)

Add a question, choose Criteria weight, and list the criteria to divide 100 points across.

![SurveyStudio's Design screen with the criteria weighting question selected and its settings panel outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/criteria-weights-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The criteria weighting question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/criteria-weights-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Criteria.** List the things weighted. The points must add up to 100.

## Best practices for research

Use points when respondents can judge all criteria at once. For many criteria, pairwise comparisons are easier to answer.

Reference: Saaty, T. L. (1980). *The analytic hierarchy process*. McGraw-Hill.
